form:FormGroup.label: Include
form:FormGroup.helpText: Regular expressions, one per line. A row is shown if its value contains a match for any of them (or matches an Include Dictionary). Parameters such as ${{key} can be used.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Regular expressions, one per line. Rows containing a match are shown.

form:FormGroup.label: Include Dictionaries
form:FormGroup.helpText: Dictionaries of values to include. Rows whose value exactly matches a dictionary word (case-sensitive) are shown; * can be used as a wildcard.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Exact, case-sensitive matches; * is a wildcard.

form:FormGroup.label: Exclude
form:FormGroup.helpText: Regular expressions, one per line. A row is hidden if its value contains a match for any of them. Parameters such as ${{key} can be used.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Regular expressions, one per line. Rows containing a match are hidden.

form:FormGroup.label: Exclude Dictionaries
form:FormGroup.helpText: Dictionaries of values to exclude. Rows whose value exactly matches a dictionary word (case-sensitive) are hidden; * can be used as a wildcard.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Exact, case-sensitive matches; * is a wildcard.
